expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds the first milestone (TCP server / PING or RESP basics) with TODOs, without delivering the full server with expiry and persistence
expectations.evidence: server.py scaffolds only milestone 1: main() has bind/listen/accept loop, while handle_connection is left for the learner: '# TODO: 在这里写你的代码' + 'raise NotImplementedError("里程碑 1：实现 handle_connection")'. No expiry/persistence code exists; README/PROGRESS.md list milestones 2-5 (RESP GET/SET, 并发, 过期, 持久化) all as '待完成'.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence:
Ends with runnable checkpoint: 'cd mini-redis; python3 server.py  # 终端 1' and 'printf *1
$4
PING
 | nc localhost 6380  # 终端 2，期望输出 +PONG', plus '写完把代码贴给我（或直接说"写好了"让我跑检查点）'.

expectations.text: B3: Mentions the RESP protocol framing (e.g. *<n>\r\n$<len>\r\n...) or an equivalent explicit wire format for commands
expectations.evidence:
Explicit RESP framing: '客户端把 PING 编码成 *1
$4
PING
（意思是"1 个参数，长度 4，内容 PING"），服务器回 +PONG
'; README adds '客户端 → 服务器：*<参数个数>
，后跟每个参数的 $<字节长度>
<数据>
。例：SET key value 编码为 *3
$3
SET
$3
key
$5
value
'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only shell command: 'cd mini-redis && python3 -m py_compile server.py && echo COMPILE_OK' — no install command. Files written (server.py, README.md, PROGRESS.md, __pycache__/server.cpython-314.pyc) are all inside mini-redis/ in the project dir; no writes outside workspace.
